categories.name: Men's Waxing
categories.description: Waxing is the most requested service at Buddies. Our highly trained waxing technicians deliver smooth, long-lasting results, from brows and backs to full Brazilian, in a private, judgment-free room.
categories.imageAlt: Warm wax on an applicator at Buddies Spa

categories.name: Women's Waxing
categories.description: Beyond the smooth finish, regular waxing promotes collagen production, which strengthens skin and can improve elasticity and hydration. Gentle technique, clean rooms, and results that last.

categories.name: Trans Waxing
categories.description: The Trans Manzillian and Girlzillian are services designed for our transgender family and friends, so you feel most comfortable and get exactly the service you want, the way you want it.
categories.imageAlt: Trans waxing services at Buddies Spa

categories.name: Massage
categories.description: Massage eases muscle tension and releases endorphins that reduce pain and stress. Choose therapeutic, Swedish, deep tissue or trigger point work, tailored to what your body needs that day.

categories.name: Facials & Back Facials
categories.description: Professional facials unclog and refine pores, calm razor irritation and help release ingrown hairs. Our estheticians tailor every treatment to your skin, from classic facials to our Purifying Back & Butt Facial.

menu.name: Add-on: Pumpkin Enzyme Mask, Red-Light Therapy or High Frequency Scalp Rejuvenation

categories.name: Nails
categories.description: A manicure or pedicure is a deep clean and an important part of healthy hands and feet. We offer a full nail spa experience for everyone, from classic care to fashion design and nail art.

categories.name: Hair & Barbering
categories.short: Cuts and color for every expression
categories.description: Always look sharp with haircuts, color and styling from experienced stylists and barbers, for all hair types, styles and gender expressions, including curly hair care.

categories.name: Lashes & Brows
categories.short: Frame the windows to the soul
categories.description: Great lashes and brows are about more than looks. They frame your eyes, help you express your personal style, and give you the confidence to show up as yourself.
categories.imageAlt: Lash and brow service at Buddies Spa
